title: Listed VC Bailador survives the SAASpocalypse with PropHero as its FY26 lucky charm
ai_summary: ASX-listed venture capital firm Bailador Technology Investments reported a decline in FY26 net profit to $6.9 million and a lower portfolio return of 2.8%, citing market uncertainty surrounding AI valuations. Despite the drop, the fund's private portfolio saw combined revenue growth of 32% to $735 million, driven by strong performances from startups such as PropHero and Updoc. The company also reduced operational costs by approximately one-third while maintaining its dividend payout at 3.5 cents per share.
